task: Test whether reaction-factorized acquisition lies outside the frontier traced by simple mixtures of exploitation and diversity.

why.what_the_first_study_settled: The preregistered dominance gate failed 0/5. Reaction-factorized acquisition does not beat both score ranking and component diversity on held-family Spearman.
why.what_it_did_not_settle: It compared the method against the endpoints of a trade-off, not against the line joining them. The method sits between top-mean (hits) and component diversity or uncertainty (learning), so a reviewer may reasonably say it is an elaborate interpolation between two simple policies.
why.question: At matched hit discovery, does the method achieve better held-family learning than the best simple mixture? Equivalently, at matched learning, does it discover more hits?

fresh_randomisation.rationale: The first study's five seeds are development evidence now: their results have been seen. This study is evaluated only on seeds never used before.

arms.mixture_definition: exploit_fraction of the batch to top-mean, remainder to component diversity, exploitation allocated first, duplicates impossible by construction
arms.second_frontier: the same grid with uncertainty sampling as the learning endpoint
arms.method: reaction_factorized, with every parameter exactly as frozen in phase1_forge_active_design_v1.json

surrogate.rationale: Chosen for an auditable closed-form posterior, not for accuracy. Every acquisition rule reads the posterior covariance, so a model whose uncertainty we cannot write down would put the uncertainty estimate and the acquisition in an unauditable loop.

features.counts_not_bits_because: binary folded Morgan fingerprints are blind to alkyl chain length; this project measured 30 generated pairs at Tanimoto 1.000 differing by 14 to 182 Da, and homologues are exactly what the generator produces
features.n_bits_rationale: 256 per block, so the design matrix is 1024-dimensional. The greedy batch loop forms Sigma M Sigma once per step, which is cubic in that dimension; 1024 keeps a full six-arm five-seed benchmark tractable while leaving the linear model far wider than the 1,100 measured lipids can constrain. Set before any benchmark result existed.

acquisition.objective: greedy budgeted maximisation of value_weight * normalised_conservative_bound + (1 - value_weight) * normalised_variance_reduction_over_target, divided by synthetic cost
acquisition.activity_floor_rationale: A hard filter applied before any trade-off, so exploration can never mean synthesising a design the surrogate expects to fail. Expressed as a quantile of the feasible pool so it does not depend on the endpoint scale.
acquisition.cost_definition: number of precursor preparations required before the final Ugi assembly
acquisition.target_population: the route-complete, prediction-supported generated population; information is measured over the designs we would actually want to rank, not over the whole space
acquisition.greedy_rather_than_exact_because: the information term is recomputed against a posterior that changes as the batch grows, and a batch of a dozen from a pool of thousands does not warrant an exact combinatorial solve

unchanged_from_the_failed_study.note: No parameter of the reaction-factorized rule may move. This study asks a new question of the same frozen method.

decision_rule.primary: position of reaction_factorized relative to the empirical Pareto frontier of the simple mixtures in the (held_family_spearman, top_decile_hits_found) plane, averaged over the fresh seeds
decision_rule.dominated_if: some simple mixture achieves both >= its Spearman and >= its hits
decision_rule.pass: reaction_factorized is not dominated by any simple mixture, and the separation exceeds the paired across-seed uncertainty
decision_rule.fail: reaction_factorized lies inside the simple-mixture frontier, or the separation is within paired uncertainty
decision_rule.consequence_if_fail: Stop the acquisition workstream permanently. The rule adds no demonstrated value beyond combining existing policies. No Library 2, no constrained reformulation, nothing in the paper.
decision_rule.consequence_if_pass: The method has value the dominance gate did not test. Only then consider the constrained batch-design formulation, and only then a confirmatory gate before any second library.

nonclaims: Passing this control does not reverse the failed dominance gate; it answers a different and narrower question.
The synthesis-cost dimension remains untested: the measured library carries no route dossier, so every candidate costs one unit and the budget binds only through batch size.
Nothing here authorises a second synthesised library.
